page.layout: Running head centred at top with page number at left; below it a full-width heading; then a woodcut engraving of a ship with winds and a figure holding an anchor; below the engraving four lines of italic verse, centred; at the bottom right a catchword.

main_text.head: SPES NON CONFVNDIT:
main_text.p: [Engraving: ship under sail with two wind-heads in the clouds, a seated female figure with an anchor and a book, sea and shore.]
main_text.l: Omnibus in lingua est: Spes non confundit at: at illa
Non est in mundi Spes iacienda bonis:
Spes non confundens caelestia munera spectat,
In viuo & solo Spes ouat vna Deo.

page.notes: The engraving is described, not transcribed. The verse is set in italic with the last two lines in roman; the printed spelling "viuo", "ouat", "vna" is left as printed. Line 1 "at: at illa" reads as printed. The catchword "Chari-" is a hyphenated word at the foot of the page.
